title: Cloud Infrastructure
desc: I design and run cloud environments on AWS and Azure, written in Terraform so they can be rebuilt the same way every time.
shortDesc: AWS and Azure environments built with Terraform, so every one is reproducible and nobody is clicking around the console.
desc1: EC2, Lambda, managed databases and Kubernetes, sized for the real load and set to auto-scale where it makes sense. IAM, network rules and monitoring go in on day one.
desc2: I also plan disaster recovery and move older systems onto the cloud. Everything is defined in Terraform or CloudFormation, so changes are reviewed in a pull request and deployments stay consistent.

process.title: Cloud Implementation Process
process.desc: The steps I follow when building a new cloud environment.

title: CI/CD Pipelines
desc: I build CI/CD pipelines that build, test and scan every change, then deploy it with a clear way to roll back.
shortDesc: Pipelines in Jenkins, GitLab CI or Azure DevOps that build, test and scan every change before it ships.
desc1: I have built pipelines in Jenkins, GitLab CI, GoCD, CircleCI and Azure DevOps. Each one runs automated tests and code quality checks, and a bad release can be rolled back quickly.
desc2: Blue-green and canary releases where they fit the app. SonarQube and Nexus IQ scans run inside the pipeline, so security and dependency problems show up before production.

process.title: CI/CD Implementation Process
process.desc: The steps I follow when building a pipeline.

title: Container Orchestration
desc: I set up and run Kubernetes and OpenShift clusters for containerised apps, with Helm and Argo CD handling deployments.
shortDesc: Kubernetes and OpenShift clusters, Helm charts and GitOps with Argo CD, set up so your team can actually run them.
desc1: Cluster design with sensible resource limits, network policies and RBAC. I containerise the applications too, and set up clusters that several teams can share safely.
desc2: Helm charts for packaging and GitOps with Argo CD, so what runs in the cluster matches what is in Git. Autoscaling and resource requests are tuned so workloads stay up without wasting capacity.

process.title: Container Platform Process
process.desc: How I take a team from containers to a platform they can run themselves.

title: SRE & Monitoring
desc: Monitoring, alerting and incident response for production systems, based on SRE practices like SLOs and error budgets.
shortDesc: Prometheus and Grafana, alerts people trust, and runbooks for when something breaks at 3am.
desc1: I define SLIs and SLOs, set error budgets and automate the first steps of incident response. Monitoring runs on Prometheus, Grafana, Zabbix and the ELK stack.
desc2: The aim is shorter outages: automated fixes for known failures, dashboards people actually use, alerts that only fire when a human is needed, and a post-mortem after every real incident.

process.title: SRE Implementation Process
process.desc: How I bring SRE practices into an existing team.
